name_input: ELECTRICFOR HEATING SYSTEMS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey company page, 'Buyers' block (India customs records): "71 | JSC AIR LIQUIDE SEVERSTAL | GAUGES BOURDON (INDIA) PVT LTD, MINCO (INDIA) PVT LTD, ELECTRICFOR HEATING SYSTEMS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, ... | 97 USTYUZHENSKAYA STR,CHEREPOVETS, VOLOGDA REGION, 162611, RUSSIA" and "7 | M/S OOO AIR LIQUIDE BALAKOVO | ELECTRICFOR HEATING SYSTEMS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, TETS-4 AREA, BYKOV OTROG VILLAGE, BALAKOVO DISTRICT, SARATOV REGION, RUSSIA, 413810" and "1 | M/S LLC AIR LIQUIDE KUZBASS | ... NOVOKUZNETSK ... RUSSIA". Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 56 Records detected", "Trading Partners 1", "Ports 3", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-26"; rows actually rendered on the free view = 5 shipment rows (all import direction) + 5 supplier rows + 4 buyer rows. Export direction is evidenced only by the aggregated buyer block (Russia, 71/7/1 shipments), NOT by a rendered line-item export row: no export date, destination port, HS code or B/L number was visible for the outbound leg.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found in the sources reachable. ImportKey shows only customs activity; Volza, Eximpedia and Trademo free views returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search returned a connection error, so domestic supply could not be checked. Not public in retrieved sources -> null.
note: Import-side facts are solid and dated: e.g. "2026-02-26 | ELECTRICFOR, S.A. | ELECTRICFOR HEATING SYSTEMS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | Hairpin heating element 10x1200mm ... HEATING RESISTORS | BARCELONA, SPAIN -> BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | 85168000 | BOL 7754971"; further rows 2026-01-12 (BOL 6832252), 2025-12-18 (BOL 6369099), 2025-10-17 (BOL 5164516), 2025-07-22 (BOL 3411480), all HS 85168000, all Spain->India. So the company is the Indian arm of Spanish parent ELECTRICFOR, S.A. (Rubi, Barcelona) importing semi-finished heating elements/cartridges into its Bangalore-area plant (Shed No.1,2,3, Survey No.127/1, Anugondanahalli Hobli, Muthukuru). Export status is marked confirmed on the strength of the buyer-side aggregation naming three Russian Air Liquide entities with shipment counts, but the free view did not expose a single dated export B/L, so the outbound leg is aggregated evidence, not a line item - treat as confirmed-with-caveat and re-verify on a paid view before quoting an export date/HS. Declared HS set (841950;851680;853620;902590) is only partly corroborated: 851680 (electric heating resistors) is confirmed on every visible record; 841950, 853620 and 902590 do not appear in any visible row and remain unverified. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the retrieved sources -> null, not estimated. No registry/catalogue data used.
